page.overview:
Who is Splinter?

Splinter was the pet rat of in Japan who learned the teachings of his owner from his cage. When Hamato Yoshi was killed by , Splinter escaped his cage which was broken during the struggle and clawed at the murderer's face, causing an enraged Saki to slice his right ear off.

After his master's death, Splinter found himself in the sewers of New York City of New York City where he found four baby turtles. One morning Splinter awoke to find the turtles playing in a glowing green "goo" spilling out of a broken canister. The five were quickly affected by this substance, growing in size and intelligence. Once they had fully mutated, Splinter taught his sons the ways of honor and the path of the ninja.

After his sons returned from their first battle, Splinter expressed concern that they had been seen, and reminded them of the way of the ninja. However, he was exasperated by interrupting his speech to order pizza, and then eschewing meditation to dance. Later that night, he waited for to return , speaking to his son about the difficulties of facing his anger.

When Raphael brought an unconscious back to the lair, Splinter cared for her until she woke, and attempted to reassure her when she panicked. He told her the story of how they were mutated and introduced the Turtles to her by name.
